items.title: YouTube Music adds new labels for AI-generated content

items.lede: YouTube is adding a "Made with AI" label to tracks that were "altered or fully generated" using AI, with a similar approach to its existing process for applying AI labels to videos. items.title: YouTube sticks new labels on AI-generated songs

items.lede: The label will appear on the player page and include songs entirely generated by AI or partially, such as involved in composition and vocals.
items.title: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
